tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List currently running macOS applications with PIDs. Does not launch apps or include a recent-app catalogue.

tools.name: get_app_state
tools.description: Explicitly observe a running, visible target window. Returns snapshot_id and the requested tree/screenshot. Call before the first action in each turn and after navigation, dialogs or reflow. Does not activate, launch or unminimize apps.

app.description: Running application name, bundle identifier, or PID returned by list_apps.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Move the visible Cozea cursor to the target, then click. Specify either element_index or both x and y. Coordinates belong to the returned screenshot, not global display coordinates. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

app.description: Running application name, bundle identifier, or PID returned by list_apps.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from get_app_state. Omit to use this session/app's latest observation.

anyOf.description: Element index from the observed accessibility tree.

click_method.description: auto selects semantic AX then targeted SkyLight/PID input. sky_click supports one or two left clicks. global requires explicit user permission and a foreground target; it may move the real pointer.

tools.name: perform_secondary_action
tools.description: Move the visible cursor, then invoke an action exposed by an indexed accessibility element. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

app.description: Running application name, bundle identifier, or PID returned by list_apps.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from get_app_state. Omit to use this session/app's latest observation.

anyOf.description: Element index from the observed accessibility tree.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Move the visible cursor to the indexed scroll region, then scroll it. Observe again before reusing screenshot coordinates. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

app.description: Running application name, bundle identifier, or PID returned by list_apps.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from get_app_state. Omit to use this session/app's latest observation.

anyOf.description: Element index from the observed accessibility tree.

pages.description: Pages to scroll, including fractional values.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag along the visible cursor path between two points from the same screenshot. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

app.description: Running application name, bundle identifier, or PID returned by list_apps.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from get_app_state. Omit to use this session/app's latest observation.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type at the current caret/selection of the observed window's focused editable control. Click that control first. This does not replace the full document value. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from get_app_state. Omit to use this session/app's latest observation.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or shortcut in the observed focused window, such as Return, Tab, super+c or Up. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.

tools.name: set_value
tools.description: Move the visible cursor to an indexed, settable AXValue control, then replace its value. Never falls back to typing or clipboard. Returns a compact acknowledgement only, never a fresh screenshot/tree. Call get_app_state when the next target depends on changed UI. Never retry automatically after DELIVERY_UNKNOWN.
